about_the_game:
THE LAWLESS ERA OF THE ENDLESS UNIVERSE

"WANT TO FEEL TRULY RETRO?"

KLOSTYN is a sci-fi retro FPS that faithfully recreates the late-'90s shooter experience.

The game follows Ethan Nova, a member of the Genesis team, sent to investigate the mysterious planet Arcadia. As they enter its orbit, they realize—too late—that the planet has already fallen under space pirate control. Their ship is attacked and crashes, leaving Ethan as the sole survivor. This is where his battle begins.

Features:

  • Authentic late-'90s low-poly models & pixelated textures

  • 6 weapons

  • 7 maps

  • 4 difficulty modes: Easy, Normal, Hard, Impossible

  • Brutal gore effects

  • Classic cinematic-style intro, ending, and cutscenes

  • Weapons with Alt-Fire

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent violence or gore, mature content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core CPU (2.0 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with support for OpenGL 3.3 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card that supports DirectSound or OpenAL.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core CPU (2.5 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with Vulkan support (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or higher, AMD RX 580 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any modern sound card that supports DirectSound, OpenAL, or Vulkan.
